notes.title: Windust 1.2.240515 Patch
notes.content:
[20240521] A tale of Wind and Dust Patch V.1.2.240515 

1. Version 1.2.240515 Update Contents:
[list]
[*] Added multi-language support, allowing in-game language switching via the menu.
[*] Implemented English support, with all interfaces and game content fully localized.
[*] Introduced horse riding sound effects on the world map.
[*] Redesigned character animations and horse riding animations on the world map.
[*] Included wooden dummy for players to test DPS at Wang Village.
[*] Adjusted map icons and city name styles for better readability in English.
[*] Enhanced quest completion condition descriptions, now listing monster locations.
[*] Provided support for OGG audio format.
[*] Fixed camera follow issue occurring after dismounting from a horse during combat entry and exit.
[*] Corrected issues with using reins on combat maps.
[*] Other adjustments, such as tweaking the map zoom scale, and more.
[/list]

2. Save Compatibility Issues:
[list]
[*] This update is compatible with previous save files; no need to start a new game.
[*] Please note that save files are not shared across different languages.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.1 Patch notes
notes.content:
tale of wind and dust Patch Update 1.1.240327
I. Version 1.1.240327 Update Contents:
	1	Added an in-game console, which can be enabled by rapidly tapping (5 times or more within 1.5 seconds) on the version information in the main menu.
	2	Updated all combat maps; high-definition resets for dungeon, wilderness, suburban, and temple map types have been implemented.
	3	Enhanced mountain effects in world map.
	4	Mini-map now has a border to clearly differentiate it from the game world.
	5	Removed network fonts.
	6	Removed the user interface style switching function; the original red theme style is now the only option.
	7	Adjusted katana attack effects and damage ranges.
	8	Reduced the drop rate of steamed buns on combat maps.
	9	Reduced the influence of movement techniques on jump height in combat maps.

II. Save Compatibility Issues
 This update supports old save files and does not require starting a new game.
	•	Due to map updates, original save files may display anomalies on combat maps; compatibility support has been added to address this issue;
	•	This compatibility support is included with this update.

III. Recent Feedback and Responses
	1	Multi-language Support
	•	Some game features and elements (such as the Tang Poem mini-game) are strongly related to Chinese content; thus, there are no plans currently for multi-language support.
	2	MacOS Support
	•	The game supports cross-platform play and is compatible with OSX and iOS; however, it lacks Apple Developer Account signing at present. Subsequent support for other platforms will be considered based on circumstances in the future.
